تختصري (form VIII)
# تَخْتَصِرِي (taḵtaṣirī) /tax.ta.sˤi.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَصَرَ (iḵtaṣara)
# تُخْتَصَرِي (tuḵtaṣarī) /tux.ta.sˤa.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَصَرَ (iḵtaṣara)
